home.feature: Home — a free PDF editor that never uploads your file

editor.feature: The editor with a PDF open — edit text, shapes, signature and redact tools

search.feature: Find — search text and automatically find personal data to redact

edit-text.feature: Edit text — fix the text in a PDF right where it is

edit-text-demo.feature: Demo of editing text and redacting a name — changing an amount in a notice, then finding and redacting a name

sign.feature: Signature — type your name or draw to make a signature

compress.feature: Compress — shrink the images inside a PDF, three levels

annotate.feature: Annotate — a text note added on top of the PDF

watermark.feature: Watermark — Confidential stamped across the page

redact.feature: Find and redact — phone numbers and emails found automatically, ready to redact

split.feature: Extract and split — save only the pages you need as a new PDF
